name: Blade slice
description: A thin white flash slashes across the frame on a slant, and the shot splits along it: the top half slides one way, the bottom half the other, with a dark gap. Then they slide back together.
when: On a hard word or a sharp claim: 'cut', 'split', a hit you want to feel.
needs: where the cut crosses the frame (about the mouth) and its slant
the cut time where it starts
